semantics.HIT: prior cache entry is correctness-equivalent and reusable
semantics.MISS: prior cache entry must not be reused
semantics.PARTIAL_INVALIDATION: only dependency-bound subentries may be reused; affected subentries must be recomputed
semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: the change class does not participate in this layer under the current governed architecture

rationale.PRICE_ONLY: Football projection and owned-lineup scoring remain reusable. Affordability and route feasibility may invalidate only finance-dependent MC/scenario subentries; stability is recomputed.
rationale.OWNED_AVAILABILITY: Private owned-player availability does not invalidate public Stage2 universe projections, but invalidates owned lineup and downstream decision compute. Scenario reuse is limited to unaffected scenario keys.
rationale.TEAM_FINANCE: Bank, selling values and FT state do not alter football projections or owned-XI scoring. Route-dependent MC/scenario entries are selectively invalidated; uncertain scope falls back to MISS.
rationale.MINI_LEAGUE_ONLY: Football projection, lineup and football-return MC remain reusable. Decision-context scenario and stability surfaces are recomputed selectively/downstream.
rationale.RUNTIME_CLASS: Cross-runtime cache reuse is forbidden unless a separately governed equivalence contract proves it.
rationale.SCENARIO_OVERRIDE: A typed P1.1 availability/xMins override may preserve unaffected Stage2 subentries only when dependency keys are explicit; downstream lineup/MC/scenario/stability must recompute.
rationale.CHALLENGER_ONLY: Context-only challengers do not alter canonical compute; scenario/stability integration is not applicable until a challenger is explicitly admitted.
